title: Organizational Leadership, B.A. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Entrance to major requires a 2.00 GPA and third-semester classification, not modeled directly. New olead_catalog.json (OLEAD 100/201/210/464/465), lhr_catalog.json (LHR 202/312/437/458Y/460). OLEAD 100->201->210->464->465 is only the bulletin's suggested sequence, not an enforced prereq chain -- confirmed each course's real prereq is either none or a semester-standing gate, not the prior OLEAD course. Several LHR courses have standing/credit-count prereqs ('5th semester standing', '3 other credits of LHR') the schema doesn't model directly, matching convention elsewhere this session. The Semester 4 'Conflict Management' pool (LHR 312/SOC 207/LHR 437/CAS 404) includes SOC 207, which itself needs SOC 1 (per the shared soc_catalog.json fix from earlier this session) -- not otherwise scheduled here, but since 3 of the 4 pool options have no prereq at all, the engine simply prefers an eligible alternative over SOC 207, same 'unused alternative' pattern as PHOTO 300/CI 312 elsewhere. 'LA 283' (the same unconfirmed code hit throughout recent Liberal Arts builds) replaced with a generic slot. This plan's computed 8-semester total (123cr) matches the bulletin's own stated total exactly. Post-parens-fix re-scrape (AND/OR prereq-parsing bug fix) revealed PSYCH 484's real prereq requires PSYCH 100 AND (PSYCH 200 or STAT 200) -- PSYCH 100 was already scheduled, but neither PSYCH 200 nor STAT 200 was, and both real-chain through MATH 21, MATH 4, and MATH 3, none of which were in the plan (MATH wasn't even in departments). Added MATH/STAT to departments and the real chain explicitly: MATH 3 (Semester 1), MATH 4 (Semester 2), MATH 21 (Semester 3), PSYCH 200 (or STAT 200, Semester 4) -- same convention used for LSCPE/ABSM's identical gap. Adds 12cr beyond the bulletin's own stated total, documented rather than silently absorbed; fits within the plan's existing 18cr/semester cap without needing a further bump.
